CentralHealthcare

Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)

The largest health assurance scheme in the world, aiming to provide free health cover of ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families.

CentralAgriculture

Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)

A central sector scheme providing income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 to all landholding farmer families across the country.

ask assistant
MaharashtraSocial Welfare & Pension

Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Pension Scheme

A state government welfare scheme in Maharashtra offering monthly financial aid/pension to destitute persons, disabled individuals, widows, and those suffering from critical illnesses.
